# Awesome Short Drama Skills

[中文](README.md) · **English** · Website: [shortdramaskills.com](https://shortdramaskills.com/en/)

> A curated list of agent skills for AI short drama (micro drama / vertical drama) and AI manju: screenwriting, adaptation, storyboards, video prompts and production. Install them into Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Qwen, Doubao or WorkBuddy and start producing.

This list collects short-drama skills for AI agents. Most use the standard SKILL.md format, so they work in Claude Code, Codex and OpenClaw, and in Chinese agents such as QwenWork, Doubao desktop, WorkBuddy, Kimi Code, Qwen Code, CodeBuddy, Trae and Qoder; see the [FAQ](#faq) for how to install them. They cover adapting novels, episode outlines, hooks and paywall points, script review, storyboards, character assets, and prompts for video models such as Seedance, MiniMax and Kling. Every project has been checked by hand and sorted by type, production stage and supported video model.

Most projects come from China's short-drama scene (Hongguo, Douyin and others), and many are documented in Chinese; the descriptions below are translated. "Manju" (漫剧) is a serialized comic-style drama, now usually generated with AI image and video models.

86 skill projects + 16 related open-source platforms · metadata updated 2026-11-02

## Which skill to install for scripts

Round 1 (2026-10-18): 10 screenwriting skills and a control with no skill installed each wrote the same open brief 3 times, judged blind by two AI reviewers (Opus and GPT). The reviewers judge as if AI will make the whole drama, so effects, crowd scenes and many locations cost no points. Both reviewers found that these 4 beat the control in all 3 runs, on both the scripts and the character bible and outline:

| Skill | Good for | Watch out for |
|---|---|---|
| [zenstory-ai/drama-skills](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills) | Short lines, characters who each sound different, emotion carried by objects | Understated episode-ending hooks |
| [Shanyin-ai/shanyin-screenwriting-master](https://github.com/Shanyin-ai/shanyin-screenwriting-master) | Short dialogue with subtext; emotion carried by actions | Restrained hooks; quiet openings |
| [jtydhr88/screenwriting-skills](https://github.com/jtydhr88/screenwriting-skills) | Emotion in actions, not inner monologue; side characters with a history | Episode-ending hooks are sometimes too mild |
| [adoria111/emma-screenwriting-skills](https://github.com/adoria111/emma-screenwriting-skills) | Restrained dialogue; side characters with motives who change | Soft episode-ending hooks; weak paywall cliffhangers |

[Hao0321/ai-short-drama](https://github.com/Hao0321/ai-short-drama) also won all 3 runs on the character bible and outline, but its scripts were uneven (Opus: one win, two ties; GPT: two wins, one loss).

Limits of this round:
- On episode-ending hooks, Opus often preferred the control and GPT did the opposite.
- On the other 6 skills' scripts, the two reviewers were far apart.
- Only one model was tested: claude-opus-5-5.
- Every skill's drafts carry numbering and checklists that must be deleted before AI production.

The full record and per-skill reviews (in Chinese): [Round 1](https://shortdramaskills.com/evals/round-1/).

## Which skill to install for premises

Round 2 (2026-10-20): 11 web novel and short drama premise skills and a control with no skill installed each chose a premise 3 times for the same kind of revenge-fantasy story, one that could become a web novel or a vertical short drama. Every entry was compared blind with every other and ranked by points. The reviewers ask whether viewers would keep watching once AI makes it. Both AI reviewers (Opus and GPT) put the same three skills on top, and all three beat the control in all 3 runs:

| Skill | Place (Opus / GPT) | Good for | Watch out for |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Tomsawyerhu/Chinese-WebNovel-Skill](https://github.com/Tomsawyerhu/Chinese-WebNovel-Skill) | 1 / 2 | Rare legal jobs and reversals of status; pitches you get in one line; payoffs that land on the opponent's face | One run is the familiar hidden-expert formula; limited fuel for a long serial |
| [lingfengQAQ/webnovel-writer](https://github.com/lingfengQAQ/webnovel-writer) | 2 / 3 | Powers with rules that cost something; the hero's flaw tied to the power | All 3 runs let the hero see numbers over people's heads; repetitive in the middle |
| [Hao0321/ai-short-drama](https://github.com/Hao0321/ai-short-drama) | 3 / 1 | The freshest premises; powers with rules; hooks with strong images | The rules leave the hero too passive, so payoffs come slowly |

The first two are in the [novel list](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-novel-skills/blob/main/README.en.md). From this list, [0xsline/short-drama](https://github.com/0xsline/short-drama) placed 4th / 7th: clever use of the law, but long pitches.

Limits of this round:
- Both reviewers placed the no-skill control 9th, with 3 skills below it.
- There was no network, so the two skills that start by checking the charts had no chart data, and they placed near the bottom.
- The two reviewers disagreed on 63 of 198 pair results, mostly in the middle of the table.
- Only one model was tested: claude-opus-5-5.

The full record and per-skill reviews (in Chinese): [Round 2](https://shortdramaskills.com/evals/round-2/).

## Which skill to install for the series outline

Round 3 (2026-10-31): the 20 skills from the first two rounds and a control with no skill installed each wrote the whole-series outline for a 60-episode short drama from the same premise card (how the whole drama unfolds, no episode outlines or scripts), 3 times each. Every entry was compared blind with every other and ranked by points. The reviewers were only told the goal: once the outline is written up and made entirely by AI, are viewers more likely to watch to the end. Both AI reviewers (Opus and GPT) put these 4 in their top five and above the control:

| Skill | Place (Opus / GPT) | Good for | Watch out for |
|---|---|---|---|
| [zhu5859243-free/hongguo-shortdrama-screenwriting](https://github.com/zhu5859243-free/hongguo-shortdrama-screenwriting) | 1 / 4 | A round every 3 to 5 episodes with evidence, counter-move and round ending spelled out, which the reviewers judged ready to hand to AI episode by episode; steady across runs | Late key evidence arrives conveniently; some leaps in reasoning |
| [adoria111/emma-screenwriting-skills](https://github.com/adoria111/emma-screenwriting-skills) | 2 / 2 | Hard rules first: an evidence ladder, a cost for every win, and when the audience and the heroine each learn what | Slow middle; you fill in the concrete rounds |
| [Tomsawyerhu/Chinese-WebNovel-Skill](https://github.com/Tomsawyerhu/Chinese-WebNovel-Skill) | 3 / 1 | Big cliffhangers pinned to episodes, each one changing the game; answers pay off early | You supply where the late key evidence comes from |
| [lixiaoxiao9888-create/short-drama-factory](https://github.com/lixiaoxiao9888-create/short-drama-factory) | 4 / 5 | A round about every 3 episodes, clear paywall points, which the reviewers judged ready for AI to expand episode by episode | Spends episodes 1–21 proving the impostor viewers already know about; reveals the killer early |

Both reviewers ranked 6 skills below the control. Most are top-level outlines that stop at sections or acts, useful when a screenwriter or AI fills in each episode afterwards; the ones in this list are [catyiqian/qianqianwriting](https://github.com/catyiqian/qianqianwriting) and [eternityspring/shuohao-skills](https://github.com/eternityspring/shuohao-skills).

Limits of this round:
- The two reviewers disagreed more than in round 2, agreeing on 332 of 630 pair results; on the other 10 skills they differ, for example Opus placed ai-short-drama 13th and GPT 3rd.
- One premise card only (a female-led revenge mystery); another genre might rank differently.
- 10 drafts went over the 3,000-character limit and were cut before judging; recounted without the comparisons they were in, each reviewer's top five stays the same.
- Only one model was tested: claude-opus-5-5.
- Only the outlines themselves were judged; this round did not test whether scripts written from them turn out well.

The full record and per-skill reviews (in Chinese): [Round 3](https://shortdramaskills.com/evals/round-3/).

**Legend**: 🌟 featured · 📝 prompt files (not a standard skill) · 🧩 full app · 🎬 supported video models · 💤 not updated for 180+ days · 📦 archived · ⚠️ repo unavailable

**Let your agent choose**: this list is also a skill. Run `npx skills add UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-short-drama-skills` to install short-drama-skill-finder, then ask your agent "I use Codex to adapt novels into short dramas. Which skill should I install?"

> [!NOTE]
> "Checked by hand" means the README, directory structure and classification were reviewed; it does not mean the output was tested. Side-by-side tests live in [evals/](evals/). A skill may ship scripts, so read its SKILL.md before installing it.

## Suggested stacks

> A first pass based on each repo's README, not yet tested; will be updated after testing.

- **Adapting a novel into a short drama**: You have a novel and need scripts and storyboards
  - Stack: [narrative-to-screen-reader](https://github.com/zhlmi/narrative-to-screen-reader) → [shuohao-skills](https://github.com/eternityspring/shuohao-skills) → [screenwriter-skill](https://github.com/Vi7QY/screenwriter-skill)
  - Why: narrative-to-screen-reader first judges whether the story can be shot and how to adapt it; shuohao-skills runs from character breakdown to storyboards; screenwriter-skill reviews the result against 38 rules
- **Original hit scripts for Hongguo / Douyin**: Turn a one-line idea into an episode-by-episode script ready to launch
  - Stack: [short-drama-factory](https://github.com/lixiaoxiao9888-create/short-drama-factory) → [qianqianwriting](https://github.com/catyiqian/qianqianwriting) → [screenwriter-skill](https://github.com/Vi7QY/screenwriter-skill)
  - Why: short-drama-factory manages episode count, paywall points and hooks; qianqianwriting adds Save the Cat beats and teardowns of hit dramas; screenwriter-skill reviews
- **Rendering with Seedance**: You already have a script and need storyboards and prompts Seedance can use
  - Stack: [Seedance2-Storyboard-Generator](https://github.com/liangdabiao/Seedance2-Storyboard-Generator) → [lanshu-awesome-ai-video-kit](https://github.com/cclank/lanshu-awesome-ai-video-kit)
  - Why: Seedance2-Storyboard-Generator splits the script into multi-episode storyboards and prompts; the lanshu kit provides Seedance prompt tuning and model selection
- **Long-running manju serial**: Make a manju of dozens of episodes without characters or foreshadowing falling apart
  - Stack: [ManjuForge](https://github.com/mengxiujie/ManjuForge) → [jingju-skills](https://github.com/jxshow/jingju-skills)
  - Why: ManjuForge tracks serial state with memory files and consistency checks; jingju-skills handles character-consistency prompts and batch image generation in ComfyUI

### Screenwriting: scripts · adaptation · review

Focused on the script itself: episode outlines, hooks, paywall points, dialogue and review.

### Upstream: IP evaluation and story breakdown

Before adapting, decide whether a story is worth shooting and how to break it down.

- **[screen-creative-skills](https://github.com/VanGong1999/screen-creative-skills)** · ★ 491<br>Film and TV development and evaluation: novel/IP evaluation, plot-point breakdown, character bios and relationships, outline, adapting novels into short drama or long series<br><sub>Stages: Topic · Adaptation · Characters · Episodes</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-20 · Chinese · 31 skills · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 The repo contains two copies of its 31 skills</sub>

- **[narrative-to-screen-reader](https://github.com/zhlmi/narrative-to-screen-reader)** · ★ 129<br>Translates your story into film-development language: quick diagnosis, a screenwriter's adaptation reader, a director's audiovisual reader, an actor's reader and a producer's summary<br><sub>Stages: Topic · Adaptation · Characters</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-01 · Chinese</sub>

- **[analyze-hit-novel](https://github.com/ciel-oliver/analyze-hit-novel)** · ★ 18<br>Hit-novel teardown: breaks a hit novel or manju into a verifiable narrative system for adaptation reference<br><sub>Stages: Topic · Adaptation · Episodes</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-04 · Chinese</sub>


<details><summary>Install commands</summary>

```bash

# narrative-to-screen-reader

```

</details>

<a id="group-craft"></a>
### Screenwriting fundamentals

Screenwriting theory beyond short drama: structure, scenes, dialogue, characters.

- 🌟 **[screenwriting-skills](https://github.com/jtydhr88/screenwriting-skills)** · ★ 1.9k<br>The most systematic screenwriting-theory set here: structure, Truby, scenes, dialogue, series bible, writers' room, with cases from Japan, Korea, France, the US and Chinese opera<br><sub>Stages: Adaptation · Characters · Episodes · Script · Review</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-03 · Chinese · 26 skills · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 Skill body is in Chinese; README is in five languages</sub>

- **[shanyin-screenwriting-master](https://github.com/Shanyin-ai/shanyin-screenwriting-master)** · ★ 1.4k<br>Shanyin Super Screenwriting Master: characters, outline, scene breakdown and full script in four formats: concept micro-film, narrative short, feature and multi-episode series<br><sub>Stages: Characters · Episodes · Script</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-04-01 💤 · Chinese · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 Distributed as a .skill file; cannot be installed with npx skills</sub>

- **[write-chinese-long-screenplay](https://github.com/mudden2380078550-creator/write-chinese-long-screenplay)** · ★ 23<br>Narrative Harness: a local state tool for writing Chinese novels and scripts; the older long-form screenplay templates remain in legacy/<br><sub>Stages: Episodes · Script</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-12 · Chinese · 2 skills · GPL-3.0</sub>

- **[claude-screenwriting](https://github.com/e06084/claude-screenwriting)** · ★ 9<br>Screenwriting knowledge engine: turns Vogler/McKee/Save the Cat into an Obsidian story wiki with 15-beat pacing, three-layer character cards and structural diagnosis<br><sub>Stages: Characters · Episodes · Review</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-08 · Chinese · 8 skills · MIT</sub>

- **[kunka-screenwriting-master](https://github.com/geslie1/kunka-screenwriting-master)** · ★ 8<br>Kunka Screenwriting Master: Chinese-first screenwriting skill set covering ideation, revision, continuity checks and series development<br><sub>Stages: Episodes · Script · Review</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-10 · Chinese · 13 skills · MIT</sub>

- **[awesome-agent-skills](https://github.com/OakcoderX/awesome-agent-skills)** · ★ 2<br>Socratic story diagnosis for novels, screenplays and series outlines: it proposes competing explanations, tests them against textual evidence, counterexamples and counterfactuals, then suggests the smallest useful revision, or none.<br><sub>Stages: Characters · Episodes · Review</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-09 · English · 2 skills · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 The repo is a fork of VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills and its front page is still that list's README; the skill lives in the socratic-story-cartographer folder.</sub>

<a id="faq"></a>
## FAQ

### What are the best agent skills for AI short dramas (microdramas)?

This list has 86 hand-checked short-drama skill projects (data updated 2026-11-02). To go from a novel all the way to storyboards and video prompts, start with the [All-in-one](#group-pipeline) group (24); the most-starred are [shuohao-skills](https://github.com/eternityspring/shuohao-skills), [drama-skills](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills) and [manju-laoli-skill](https://github.com/lixiaoxiao9888-create/manju-laoli-skill). Missing just one step? Look it up in [By production stage](#by-stage). Not sure how to combine them? Start from [Suggested stacks](#packs).

### What is an AI short drama skill (manju skill)?

A capability pack for AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Qwen and Doubao. A skill is a folder built around a `SKILL.md` file, sometimes with scripts and templates. Once it's installed, the agent follows it for one step of making a short drama: breaking a novel into an episode outline, writing a vertical-drama script, building a storyboard or writing video prompts for Seedance.

### Can Claude Code or Codex make an AI short drama?

Yes. Of the 86 projects, 84 use the standard `SKILL.md` format, which Claude Code, Codex and other agents that support Agent Skills can install. 28 repos say they support Claude Code and 30 say they support Codex. Install a standard skill with `npx skills add owner/repo`; each group ends with ready-made install commands.

### Can I use them in Chinese agents such as Qwen, Doubao, OpenClaw or WorkBuddy?

Yes. Any agent that supports skills can load a standard `SKILL.md` skill:

- **QwenWork** (Alibaba): put the skill folder in `~/.qwenworkcn/skills/`
- **Doubao desktop** (ByteDance): open the Skills page, click "+ Add" and upload the skill folder
- **OpenClaw**: `npx skills add owner/repo -a openclaw`
- **WorkBuddy** (Tencent): put the skill folder in `~/.workbuddy/skills/`
- **Kimi Code, Qwen Code, CodeBuddy, Trae, Qoder, Lingma, MiniMax Code**: `npx skills add owner/repo -a name`, where the names are `kimi-code-cli`, `qwen-code`, `codebuddy`, `trae` (China edition `trae-cn`), `qoder` (China edition `qoder-cn`), `lingma` and `minimax-code`

Each entry lists only the agents its repo explicitly names; an unlisted agent may still work. See the [install guide](https://shortdramaskills.com/en/guides/install/) for every agent's directory.

### Which short drama skills work with Seedance?

Of the 44 projects that name a video model, 35 support Seedance (Jimeng), more than any other; next are MiniMax H3 (15) and Kling (8). The most-starred Seedance projects are [seedance2-skill](https://github.com/dexhunter/seedance2-skill), [Seedance2-Storyboard-Generator](https://github.com/liangdabiao/Seedance2-Storyboard-Generator) and [awesome-seedance](https://github.com/LearnPrompt/awesome-seedance). See [By video model](#by-model) for the full list.

### Are there skills for short drama scripts and storyboards?

Yes. 43 projects cover the Script · dialogue stage; the most-starred script specialists (3 stages or fewer) are [shanyin-screenwriting-master](https://github.com/Shanyin-ai/shanyin-screenwriting-master), [seedance-2-5-video-director](https://github.com/liyue-aigc/seedance-2-5-video-director) and [film-studio-skills](https://github.com/machina-exm/film-studio-skills). 48 cover the Storyboard · shot design stage; the most-starred storyboard specialists are [shanyin-director-master](https://github.com/Shanyin-ai/shanyin-director-master), [visual-skills](https://github.com/smixs/visual-skills) and [lanshu-awesome-ai-video-kit](https://github.com/cclank/lanshu-awesome-ai-video-kit). See the [Screenwriting](#group-writing) and [Storyboards · visual assets · video prompts](#group-visual) groups.

### How do I adapt a novel into a short drama script with AI?

Use adaptation skills and have the agent work step by step: break down the novel → adaptation outline → episode outlines and hooks → episode scripts → review. 22 projects cover the Adaptation (novel → script) stage; the most-starred are [shuohao-skills](https://github.com/eternityspring/shuohao-skills), [drama-skills](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills) and [Seedance2-Storyboard-Generator](https://github.com/liangdabiao/Seedance2-Storyboard-Generator). To judge whether a novel is worth adapting first, see [Upstream: IP evaluation and story breakdown](#group-source) (3).

### How are skills different from Coze workflows or short-drama agent apps like Xiaoyunque?

Coze workflows and apps such as Xiaoyunque and LibTV are built and run inside their own platforms. A skill is a set of instructions you install into your own agent: the same skill works in QwenWork, Doubao, OpenClaw or Claude Code, and you can combine it with other skills and change it to fit your workflow. They also work together: write the script, storyboard and prompts with skills, then render in Jimeng, Kling or Xiaoyunque. For self-hosted open-source short-drama platforms, see [Related open-source platforms](#group-platform).

### Are these skills safe to install?

Every repo was checked by hand: README, folders and files. So far 206 repos have been reviewed: 86 skill projects and 16 open-source platforms made the list, and the other 104 didn't. The reasons are listed in [data/ignore.toml](data/ignore.toml) (in Chinese); one of them copied a popular skill and then pushed an installer download. A normal skill is a few text files and never needs an .exe or .dmg. Skills can ship scripts, so read the `SKILL.md` before installing.

### How often is the list updated?

Every Monday, stars, last-updated dates and licenses refresh automatically and new repos are searched; new repos are added only after a manual check. See [New this week](#new).

<a id="resources"></a>
## Resources

- [awesome-story-skills](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-story-skills/blob/main/README.en.md): open-source methods for getting LLMs to tell stories; covers the script and story side (outlines, characters, review, de-AI), with a method guide
- [PAMPAS-Lab/awesome-ai-short-drama](https://github.com/PAMPAS-Lab/awesome-ai-short-drama): a resource list on AI short-drama production, focused on open-source systems, research papers and commercial products
- [zhaotoday/awesome-ai-video](https://github.com/zhaotoday/awesome-ai-video): an overview of AI video production resources, from short-drama platforms to editing, ComfyUI and distribution
- [awesome-novel-skills](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-novel-skills/blob/main/README.en.md): skills for writing novels and web fiction, the usual source material for short-drama adaptation
- [awesome-social-media-skills](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-social-media-skills/blob/main/README.en.md): social media skills for publishing and promoting the finished drama on Douyin, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, YouTube and more
- [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills): the official Agent Skills repo with the spec and examples, a good starting point for writing your own skill
- [vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills): the `npx skills` installer, with the [skills.sh](https://skills.sh) directory
- [VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills](https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills): a general list of agent skills

## Contributing

Suggest a project by [opening an issue](../../issues/new?template=submit-skill.yml), or edit `data/skills.toml` and open a PR; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) (in Chinese; English issues and PRs are welcome). Your own short-drama skill is welcome too.
